selection: First 25 alphabetically among published self_hostable T–Z apps with empty install-option rows.
snapshot_source: Read-only query of public.self_host_apps and public.self_host_app_install_options on 2026-09-30.
source_policy: Official project docs, publisher repositories and publisher-owned packages only.

summary.note: Tasmota has an official firmware flashing route; Teikei documents production deployment on Dokku; TiddlyPWA documents a DIY sync server. Terrateam has Open Source routes; its current Stategraph branding is flagged.

field_guard_assumptions: App updates require the id, slug, published/self_hostable state, install URL, Docker URL/image, Compose URL, deployment methods and support flags to match the read-only snapshot.
Install-option updates require options=[] and every destination URL/image array to be empty.
Tasmota, Teikei and TiddlyPWA remain published/self_hostable because their official sources document user-controlled device firmware, Dokku deployment, and a DIY sync server, respectively.
App updates change only reviewed install fields and merge source links or related technical-fact keys; unrelated app facts are preserved.
The migration is a reviewed draft and has not been applied to production.
